name: a healthy environment reports no setup issues
description: GET /api/db/setup-issues runs the checks Phorge's PhabricatorDatabaseSetupCheck / PhabricatorMySQLSetupCheck run — version, InnoDB, the meta_data database, and a set of server variables — and returns one SetupIssue per finding, with IsFatal matching Phorge's own. The seeded node passes every check (modern MySQL, InnoDB present, meta_data created, sane variables), so the array is empty. That empty array is the contract for 'this install is ready'.
